jtbd.jtbd_title: Build JCamp application and seed strategic relationships
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Craft compelling JCamp app; define mentor pipeline; ship 2 touches/week with proof-of-work links.

interactions.user_ask: What will make my JCamp app stand out?
interactions.jenny_reply: Lead with a unique beat you’ve actually covered. Link 1–2 published pieces or interview clips—proof over claims.

interactions.user_ask: How do I find and approach mentors?
interactions.jenny_reply: Create a 3-tier mentor map (local journalists → alumni → AAJA community). Send a 3-sentence ask with two specific next steps.

interactions.user_ask: What cadence keeps momentum without spamming?
interactions.jenny_reply: Two touches a week, each with a new micro-proof—one short clip or paragraph write‑up you can show.
Start a mini-CRM: name, handle, last touch, next step, artifact link. Review every Sunday night.
